chunks: We shall certainly test you until We make known those who strive among you and those who are patient, and We will verify your reports.
ai.seo_question: What is the wisdom behind divine trials (balāʾ) in Islam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights that divine trials (balāʾ) serve not merely as tests but as a means of distinguishing the sincere from the hypocritical through active striving (jihād) and steadfast patience (ṣabr). The phrase 'akhbārukum' is interpreted by scholars like Al-Tabarsi as referring to the verification of their reported deeds and narratives, ensuring that outward actions align with inner faith. This process of purification prepares believers for the ultimate reality of the Hereafter, where true merit is fully revealed.
